007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.agent;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.SelectAIAgent;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.Team;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
013
014/** Demonstrates granting team access through an owner-scoped {@link Team} handle. */
015public final class GrantTeamHandleAccessSample {
016
017    private GrantTeamHandleAccessSample() {
018    }
019
020    /**
021     * Grants the configured database user or role permission to run the loaded team.
022     *
023     * @param args command-line arguments; not used
024     * @throws SelectAIException when an SDK operation fails; the process exits unsuccessfully
025     */
026    public static void main(String[] args) throws SelectAIException {
027        String teamName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_SHARED_TEAM_NAME");
028        String grantee = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_SHARED_TEAM_GRANTEE");
029        try (SelectAIAgent client = createClient()) {
030            boolean granted = client.team(teamName).grantAccess(grantee);
031            System.out.printf("Team handle access grant completed: %s%n", granted);
032            System.out.printf("Team: %s%n", teamName);
033            System.out.printf("Grantee: %s%n", grantee);
034        }
035    }
036
037    private static SelectAIAgent createClient() throws SelectAIException {
038        return SelectAIAgent.create(DbConnectionConfig.builder()
039                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
040                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
041                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
042                .build());
043    }
044
045    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
046        String value = System.getenv(name);
047        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
048            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
049        }
050        return value;
051    }
052}
